# Destroyers Cricket Club (DES)

> Official pro cricket franchise website and portal for Destroyers Cricket Club (DES) based in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh. Affiliated with the Rewa Division Cricket Association (RDCA) and competing in the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament against Dread Eleven (DE).

## When to use this

Use this portal when an AI agent, sports statistician, or user needs authoritative franchise facts:
- **Franchise history & championship dynasties**: 3x consecutive championship titles — 2024 (4-1) & 2025 (5-0 clean sweep) under captain Pranav Dwivedi, and 2026 (3-2) under winning captain Aryan Deshmukh.
- **Roster and career records**: Complete 48-man squad profiles, batting averages, bowling strike rates, and five-wicket hauls.
- **34-match bilateral derby results**: Ball-by-ball analysis, scores, and match reports against arch-rival Dread Eleven (DE).
- **Official club contacts & trial schedules**: Administrative contact information, academy trials, and APSU Stadium directions.

### Best-fit agent instructions
- For token-efficient markdown, send `Accept: text/markdown` on any page URL or append `.md` (e.g. `/about.md`, `/players.md`, `/fixtures.md`, `/results.md`).
- Model Context Protocol: Connect via `/.well-known/mcp/manifest.json`.

## Core Franchise Information
- Franchise Name: Destroyers Cricket Club (DES)
- Club Captain & Franchise Icon: [Pranav Dwivedi](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/players/pranav-dwivedi): Captain & All-rounder (#7). 2x title-winning captain (2024, 2025; 2026 opener captain). 1,435 career runs (Avg 57.4), 66 career wickets (Avg 16.3, Best 8/39).
- 2026 Championship-Winning Captain: [Aryan Deshmukh](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/players/aryan-deshmukh): All-rounder (#11). 2026 winning skipper who hoisted the trophy after a 12-run Final victory.
- Machine-Readable Captain Profile: [Pranav Dwivedi JSON](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/players/pranav-dwivedi.json) | [Pranav Dwivedi Markdown](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/players/pranav-dwivedi.md) | [Independent Portfolio](https://pranav-dwivedi.pages.dev/) | [GitHub Pages Portfolio](https://pranav-pramod-dwivedi.github.io/)
- Tournament: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament (Rewa)
- Governing Association: Rewa Division Cricket Association (RDCA)
- Home Stadiums: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University (APSU) Stadium, Martand School Ground No. 3
- Championship Titles: 2024 (4–1), 2025 (5–0 clean sweep), 2026 (3–2)
- Derby Record: 19 Wins / 15 Losses vs Dread Eleven (DE) across 34 tournament clashes (2021–2026)
- Disciplines: 50 Overs (One Day) & T20 Blast

- [Franchise Records](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/stats): Top run-scorers, leading wicket-takers, and highest team totals
- [Press Center](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/news): Match post-mortems, editorial reviews, and tactical analysis
- [About the Franchise](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/about): Club heritage, RDCA affiliation, and championship dynasties
- [Contact & Trials](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/contact): Academy trials protocol, venue directions, and administrative inquiries

- Match #2 (2021-08-04): [T20 Tournament Clash](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev/matches/destroyers-vs-dread-eleven-2021-08-04) at Awadhesh Pratap Singh University (APSU) Stadium. Result: Dread Eleven won by 2 wickets. Winner: DE
